source: BitBuilt PSP 3000 rear.stl, body coords, 1mm zmax

door_trough_extension.note: deep channel continues past y=58 (door side) to y=70; the UMD lid scan shows the door itself is a ~1.4-2mm thin shell, so the trough depth is set by the rear-shell walls, not the lid

opb_implication: Main opening 47x50mm + trough extension. OPi Zero 2W is 65mm long: it cannot fit flat in the cavity in any single plane (already excluded in mechanical-layout.md OP-A). The split-z OP-B placement must span cavity floor (z~1.5 datum + board 1.2mm) and a second level over the trough; the 5mm component envelope vs rim z~8.7 leaves ~2-3mm headroom per level. The cut study (UMD-mechanism-only structures) extends X past 168 under the door trough on the door side.
